com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AIConfigDefault.AbstractBuilder<B extends AIConfigDefault.AbstractBuilder<B>>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIConfigDefault.AbstractBuilder<B>
  • Type Parameters:
    B - the concrete builder subtype
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AIAgentConfigDefault.Builder, AICompletionConfigDefault.Builder, AIJudgeConfigDefault.Builder
    Enclosing class:
    AIConfigDefault

    protected abstract static class AIConfigDefault.AbstractBuilder<B extends AIConfigDefault.AbstractBuilder<B>>
extends java.lang.Object
    Base builder holding the fields shared by every default config type.

    Uses the curiously recurring generic pattern so that the shared setters return the concrete builder subtype for fluent chaining.
